_comment: LV-6 G1 CENSUS ARM (SPEC_level_authority_internal.md §4 G1 / §5 item 5).
50 solve + 1 consumer, 480 epochs = 4 h @ 30 s, over the REGENERATED wsh-class fixture
runs/simnet50_wsh_f29p5, which carries the §29.5 empirical receiver-GF-bias distribution
as truth (truth_rx_bias.csv per station).  Grade the SETTLED half only -- the level
channel's convergence budget is ~2 h, so G1's '>= 2 h' is a floor on the SETTLED window,
not on the arc.
network.rank_gate_tol = 1e-12 is MEASURED on THIS fixture, not inherited: the 40-epoch
probe (runs/lv6g1_wsh50_probe/run/logs/network_estimability.csv, 6 dumped epochs) gives
clock gauge depth     |ev| <= 1.03e-10   (CLK|G.. uniform 0.1768 = 1/sqrt(32))
extra near-null       1.3389e-05 .. 1.3391e-05   (PB|*|L2W common mode, n-INVARIANT)
weakest real layer    4.21e-02 .. 4.63e-02
tol 1e-12 puts the cutoff at 9.28e-08 .. 9.35e-08: 2.9e+03x ABOVE the gauge depth and
143x BELOW the near-null.  Never set this globally -- assertNullSpaceRank throws in
BOTH directions.  Without it this arm emits 0/480 (the probe measured 0 emitted /
40 gate-withheld), exactly as SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network §12.2 rung 1 did.
MEASURED on the probe, so the §29.5 sign is settled by measurement and not by argument:
* The census observable is RAW code.  cs.val = I1 - (b1-b2)/(gamma-1) - (B1-B2)/(gamma-1)
(ApplicationNetworkAssembly.cpp:1440 'i_code = -row.gf_code_m / row.gf_denom';
NetworkRawObservables.hpp:70-71 gf_code_m = P1-P2, gf_denom = gamma-1 = 0.646944).
Derived coefficient on the injected receiver GF bias: -1/(gamma-1) = -1.5457 L1 m per
metre = -9.5196 SLANT TECU per metre, then divided by the LOS mapping.
* Probe regression of the 50 per-station tier-1 means on the injected g = b(C1C)-b(C2W):
slope -9.869 vertical TECU per metre (corr -0.72), intercept +32.36 TECU -- the
intercept IS the truth field's fleet-mean vertical level (GIM DOY-129 ~32 TECU), and
the slope implies an effective mapping M_eff = 0.965 (the info weights favour the
high-elevation LOS).  The mechanism is confirmed end to end.
* Probe FLEET L_cs = +47.6 TECU (min 46.9 / max 48.6 over 31 epochs, MAD ~24).  With
an injected solve-roster MEDIAN g of -2.3327 m the bias term is +22.2 slant / +23.0
vertical TECU, so this fixture drives the census level UP, not down.
* THE FIELD (G2) EXPECTS -10..-20 VERTICAL TECU.  Under this code path a NEGATIVE fleet
(C1C - C2W) raises the level, so §29.5's '-5 ns / -1.55 m' and its 'a00 low by 11-15
TECU' cannot both be in the (C1C - C2W) convention.  To reproduce the FIELD DIRECTION
in sim, regenerate the fixture with the roster sign flipped -- one flag, see
config/sim/simnet50_wsh_f29p5.json's header.  G1's own pass/fail is sign-agnostic
(it grades L_cs against the census operator applied to TRUTH), so this arm is valid
either way; the flip is what makes the sim PREDICT the field.
* Median-vs-mean skew, quantified (the reason §5 item 5 mandates the median): the
injected fleet MEAN is -1.61 m (-15.3 TECU) but the MEDIAN is -2.33 m (-22.2 TECU),
so a mean-statistic reference would mis-state the confound by ~7 TECU.
G1 pass criteria (pre-registered, unchanged): corr(L_cs, censusOperator{truth}) >= +0.8
settled, offset ~ the MEDIAN of the injected biases, |d offset/dt| <= 2 TECU/h settled.
Stop rule: corr < +0.5 => the fleet reduction is not measuring the level; record, do not
tune the reduction.
